watches.name: Skindiver Automatic 38 mm Dive Watch - Pink October Edition
watches.description: This 38 mm Skindiver Automatic – Pink October Edition features a matte pink dial created for Pink October, with a triangle at 12 o'clock , the inscription "MARSEILLE FRANCE" at 6 o'clock , and a distinctive female diver illustration created by Lauriane Abbe, a French Armed Forces artist and French Navy reserve officer . The hands and hour markers feature BGW9 Super-LumiNova® for excellent legibility in low-light conditions. Developed by Wolbrook with the technical and design guidance of Mr Jacques Bianchi , this special edition also features a uniquely engraved caseback , a glass-box sapphire crystal , a 316L stainless steel case, 200 m / 20 ATM water resistance , a signature destro screw-down crown positioned at 9 o'clock , and Wolbrook's HexapleX® shock-resistant architecture . Powered by the reliable Citizen/Miyota 9039 automatic movement with an approximately 42-hour power reserve , this Skindiver is available on a white or black Tropic rubber strap or a 316L stainless steel 3-link bracelet . watches.name: Flight Computer Automatic Watch - ENAC - Special Edition
watches.description: This Flight Computer Automatic Watch Special Edition ENAC features a blue sunray dial highlighted by the ENAC logo and C3 Super-LumiNova® . At its center, the modernized Wolbrook iconic arrow minute hand ensures sharp legibility, protected under a glass-box sapphire crystal . Housed in a 316L stainless steel case , this versatile timepiece is water-resistant to 150 m , with both screw-down crown and caseback ensuring reliability. This Flight Computer Automatic watch, powered by the Japanese Citizen/Miyota 8315 automatic movement with a 60-hour power reserve (approx.), comes equipped with a choice of a dark blue Tropic rubber strap , a two-piece blue leather strap or a 316L stainless steel bracelet. Important: This special edition is exclusively available to the ENAC school alumnis and staffs. The financial transaction is between ENAC school alumnis and staffs choosing to purchase this special edition watch and Wolbrook Watches. HOW DOES THE ORDER OF THIS SPECIAL EDITION WORK? To optimize production and costs, the Flight Computer Automatic – ENAC – is offered through pre-order . Once the pre-order phase is closed, Wolbrook customer service will contact you to confirm the personalized details of your watch. Manufacturing of the personalized components will then take about 6 to 8 weeks . Taking into account the holiday closure, the estimated delivery window runs from the end of January to the end of February 2026 . Wolbrook has extensive experience in both watch manufacturing and managing pre-orders. Even during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, our operations and deliveries remained unaffected. We always deliver. watches.name: JetFlyer Automatic Chronograph - Vintage
watches.description: The JetFlyer® Automatic Chronograph brings together the iconic proportions of the original 1950s Skindiver® case with modern French watchmaking. Designed as a true tool-watch, it combines functional chronograph capability, mechanical sophistication, and everyday durability. The stainless steel case measures 38 mm at the bezel (37 mm mid-case) with a thickness of 12.1 mm (14.3 mm including the glass box sapphire crystal ) and a comfortable 46 mm lug-to-lug length. It features a screw-down crown and caseback ensuring 100 m water resistance , drilled lugs for easy strap changes, and a 120-click unidirectional rotating bezel combining a 60-minute dive scale with a 12-hour secondary time-zone indication. The matte black dial focuses on clarity and functionality, with two chronograph subdials (30-minute and 12-hour counters), extended markers at 3, 6, and 9 minutes inspired by traditional telephone timing intervals, and a discreet tachymeter scale. "Old Radium" Super-LumiNova® X1 grade is applied to all hands and markers, including Wolbrook’s signature arrow-shaped minute hand and oversized “lollipop” chronograph seconds hand. Powered by the Jeambrun PS 6402 automatic chronograph movement , beating at 28,800 vibrations per hour with a 55-hour power reserve , the watch showcases modern mechanical architecture. Through the exhibition caseback, the movement reveals its distinctive Armure de France finish — an interwoven hexagonal pattern symbolizing strength, precision, and French craftsmanship. The JetFlyer ® Chronograph is paired with a two-piece rally-style leather strap crafted from Italian vegetable-tanned leather and secured with a signed 316L stainless steel pin buckle. This Skindiver WT Automatic Special Edition Dinan Aeroclub features a blue dial highlighted by the Dinan Aeroclub logo and C3 Super-LumiNova® . At its center, the modernized Wolbrook iconic arrow hand ensures sharp legibility, protected under a glass-box sapphire crystal . Housed in a 316L stainless steel case , this versatile timepiece is water-resistant to 150 m , with both screw-down crown and caseback ensuring reliability. This Skindiver WT Automatic watch, powered by the Japanese Citizen/Miyota 8315 automatic movement with a 60-hour power reserve (approx.), comes equipped with a choice of a dark blue Tropic rubber strap , a one-piece blue leather strap or a 316L stainless steel beads-of-rice bracelet . Important: This special edition is exclusively available to the members of the Aeroclub of Dinan . The financial transaction is between Dinan Aeroclub members choosing to purchase this special edition watch and Wolbrook Watches. HOW DOES THE ORDER OF THIS SPECIAL EDITION WORK? To optimize production and costs, the Skindiver WT Automatic – Dinan Aéroclub – is offered through pre-order . Once the pre-order phase is closed, Wolbrook customer service will contact you to confirm the personalized details of your watch. Manufacturing of the personalized components will then take about 6 to 8 weeks . Taking into account the holiday closure, the estimated delivery window runs from mid-December 2025 to the end of January 2026 . Wolbrook has extensive experience in both watch manufacturing and managing pre-orders. Even during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, our operations and deliveries remained unaffected. We always deliver. MN90 Decompression Tables are the " Marine Nationale " (French Navy) diving tables defined in 1990, indicating the stops that must be made after dives of certain durations at specific depths. This automatic Skindiver watch powered, by the Japanese Citizen/Miyota 8315 automatic movement with a 60-hour power reserve (approx.), comes equipped with a choice of a black , sky blue, or yellow Tropic rubber strap, or a 316L stainless steel beads-of-rice bracelet . or a 3-link bracelet. Movement note: This watch is part of the final production fitted with the Miyota 8315. Following its discontinuation by Miyota, future Skindiver Decompression Automatic production will feature the dedicated no-date Miyota 82S0 with no ghost date position—a purposeful evolution in line with the collection’s “less is more” philosophy.
